scope: existing C3 CO BG 11 traces only; CPU postprocessing; no FDTD, test families, training or G4 relief

operators.tail_removed: U=X-WX; W is exactly the archived official 200ns receiver-only taper
operators.transform: official direct_frequency_response with identical original source, no added taper on U; reconstruct rectangular, zero_pad_factor=4, time_shift=0

required_checks: source samples, dt, time origin, spatial scale identical across 11 traces
saved reconstruction and raw samples use their respective physical time axes
official F(U) equals archived E_no_taper-E_tail, arithmetic comparison only
C(E_no)=C(E_tail)+C(F(U)); no independence assumed for norm squares
metrics: raw centered L2, squared-norm share, per-trace centered norm and raw mean/last sample
raw centered squared-norm share in actual nonzero taper support; support defined by official weights, not observed amplitudes
reconstruction window centered before/after/removed norms, relative closure and after/before norm; zero denominator null
per-trace receiver y and distance to lateral PML inner interfaces at y=1,31 m; descriptive only
interpretation: operation attribution only; no physical PML/finite-domain/truncation cause certification, no clean truth or numerical error budget; no output-selected windows or best taper search
